name: London
description: London remains the UK's most liquid property market, driven by international demand, strong transport links, and constant regeneration across zones 2-4.

name: Manchester
description: Manchester is the North's economic powerhouse, with major regeneration in the city centre and Salford Quays driving consistently strong rental yields.

name: Birmingham
description: Birmingham benefits from HS2 investment, a young population, and one of the UK's fastest-growing city centre rental markets.

name: Leeds
description: Leeds has the largest financial and legal sector outside London, supporting steady tenant demand and city centre growth.

name: Liverpool
description: Liverpool consistently ranks among the UK's top yield cities, with affordable entry prices and a large student and young professional rental base.

name: Glasgow
description: Glasgow offers strong rental demand driven by its universities and growing tech sector, with prices still well below UK city averages.

name: Bristol
tagline: Tech hub with strong capital growth
description: Bristol's booming tech and creative sectors have driven some of the strongest capital growth of any UK city outside London.

name: Edinburgh
tagline: Stable capital growth, low void periods
description: Edinburgh combines strong tourism, finance, and university sectors, resulting in some of the lowest rental void periods in the UK.
